title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Calculation Standard for State Compensation Decisions Made in 2012 Concerning Infringement of Citizens' Right to Personal Freedom
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Calculation Standard for State Compensation Decisions Made in 2012 Concerning Infringement of Citizens' Personal Freedom

Fa [2012] No. 134

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

Article 33 of the National Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where personal freedom of a citizen is infringed, the daily compensation shall be calculated based on the average daily wage of employees in the preceding year of the State."

According to the 2011 average annual wage of employees in urban non-private units (i.e., the former "national average annual wage of on-the-job employees") released by the National Bureau of Statistics on May 29, 2012, the 2011 average annual wage of employees in urban non-private units was RMB 42,452. Based on the calculation formula for the average daily wage provided by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the standard for the average daily wage is RMB 42,452 (yuan) ÷ 12 (months) ÷ 21.75 (monthly statutory remunerative days) = RMB 162.65. Accordingly, when making state compensation decisions in 2012, people's courts at all levels shall set the daily compensation for infringement of citizens' personal freedom at RMB 162.65.

This notice is hereby given and shall be complied with accordingly.

May 29, 2012
